long_description: SteadyMD is a B2B telehealth infrastructure company that provides enterprises with a managed 50-state clinician workforce and white-label virtual care technology. Founded in 2016 originally as a direct-to-consumer concierge primary care service, the company pivoted to B2B infrastructure and became the backbone for major digital health brands including Amazon Clinic and Lemonaid Health. In October 2025, DocGo acquired SteadyMD to combine last-mile healthcare delivery with virtual care capabilities. The company maintains a roster of over 600 board-certified physicians, nurse practitioners, and therapists handling 200,000+ patient visits per month. SteadyMD generated approximately $25 million in revenue in 2025 and is expected to be EBITDA positive in 2026. The platform handles recruiting, credentialing, training, scheduling, and multi-state compliance, allowing digital health companies to launch telehealth programs without building clinical operations internally.

faqs.q: How big is SteadyMD's clinician network?
faqs.a: SteadyMD maintains over 600 board-certified physicians, nurse practitioners, and therapists handling 200,000+ patient visits per month across all 50 states.

faqs.q: How is SteadyMD different from Wheel?
faqs.a: Both are B2B telehealth infrastructure providers. SteadyMD is now part of DocGo (acquired October 2025) while Wheel remains independent. SteadyMD notably powers Amazon Clinic and Lemonaid Health.
